title: eas-flow plugin configuration
description: Per-project configuration consumed by the eas-flow Claude Code skills.

repo.description: GitHub repository as owner/repo. If omitted, resolved via `gh repo view`.

appDir.description: Path to the Expo app root (where npm/eas commands run).

appConfigPath.description: Path to app.json / app.config.json holding expo.version and build number.

integrationBranch.description: Integration branch that feature branches merge into.

productionBranch.description: Production branch that releases are cut to.

easProfile.description: EAS build profile to use for production builds.

labelPrefixMap.description: Maps GitHub issue labels to branch/commit prefixes.

storeUrl.description: Optional App Store / Play Store URL used in release notes.
